dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: The harbor is not a place where waters and ships cross paths, but also one where stories gather.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Many tourists, merchants, and even lovers of books from the land of deserts and rainforests come here.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Many people love chatting with me, because that would be the first time they've ever met a Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Thanks to everyone, I've also heard lots of stories from beyond these waters. It's great working here.
